The eight line brief

vibeA weaver's bench in morning light: butter ground, white weft bands, indigo thread, everything lives on five columns that run the full width of the page.
heroFive taut Three.js warp threads stand edge to edge behind the H1 at top left; the day's weft passes and knots once on each, the reed sweeps toward the camera through the woven weeks, the knots pull tight on a held beat, then the world flips top down and the cloth lays flat into the five column board.
typeBig Shoulders Display condensed headings over Manrope body; the H1 glyphs start at weight 500 like slack thread and pull to 800 left to right as the weft passes (The Tightening).
paletteLight field: butter #F6E7A1 ground, white #FFFFFF weft bands, indigo #2B2F8F thread with deep indigo #1B1E5C and ink #14163A; one hue family, the story is butter warp through a white weft with indigo thread.
motionShuttle easing (fast in, long settle) for travel and Knot easing (overshoot and tighten) for arrivals, 0.11 / 0.38 / 1.2s; the loader is a dashed indigo running stitch drawing down the left gutter in step with real load; every section is a weft pass that wipes in across the columns; the Bobbin button runs its stitches on hover.
speechEvery section heading is a question in the visitor's own voice (What's in today's pass? Which threads should you pull first?); CTAs are 'Add the Daily to my cart' and 'Open ...' verbs; the guides are titled as a how to, a negation, a comparison and a why (The national average savings rate is not a benchmark, it is a warning); About opens with a craftsman's complaint about bad writing.
rhythmRows across five fixed columns: each section is a row that spans all five, heading passes on butter sit between rows, the membership row gives each plan a column and the fifth column carries the free tier over a photograph at 30 percent.
